profile.headline: Senior Web Developer at Intuit

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
• Design and implementation of windows and web services used in two way synchronizing order data between the phone and web channels
• Design and implementation of web based administrative user interfaces for handling order synchronization exceptions
• Design and implementation of an Image Processing Service used for the conversion, manipulation and presentation of images
• Design and implementation of tools to securely push minor changes to the production environment without the need of a formal release
• Design and implementation of windows services to synchronize user image collections with partners
• Design and implementation of a custom Javascript MVC/P framework used for the visual configuration of customization of products
• Design and implementation of Cross-Sell capabilities to better target customers to offer more customized experiences
• Design and implementation of the Data Layer for the promotion engine component used in applying offers customers
• Design and implementation of the encryption and hashing of passwords stored by the application
• Assisted in the migration from Commerce Server to .Net by removing/replacing dependencies
• Design and implementation of a custom integration with Siebel to enhance the configuration component of multi-option products
• Report generation and monitoring using SPLUNK
• Assist in Data Center Migration
• Assist in the Integration with multiple partners for the purposes of sharing aggregated data
• Design and implementation of a database driven Match Engine 
• Design and implementation of a web application used in the configuration of the Match Engine
• Design and implementation Data Layer Scripting and deployment Tools

positions.title: Contractor - Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Improved overall performance of the Intuit Market E-Commerce site
•	Designed and implemented the application used to redirect and maintain vanity urls.  Code included the design and implementation of an ISAPI filter and a single ASP page.
•	Product preview engine re-implementation to increase fidelity between HTML and PDF proofs.
•	Updated PDF preview generation code to enhance quality and performance.
•	Consolidation & optimization of preexisting asp pages.
•	Performed load tests to identify potential bottlenecks and points of failure.
•	Performed analysis of server and application logs & dumps to determine root causes of failures.
•	Modified logo processing engine to output higher quality images using Java.
•	SQL stored procedure optimization.
•	Design and creation of tools used to acceleration development and deployment process.
•	Responsible for the integration of the BeFree affiliate program.

positions.title: Software Engineer Contractor
positions.description:
•	Worked closely with the operations, accounting and sales departments to determine the business requirements and workflow.
•	Design and implementation of a web based system to manage and track reusable containers and palettes.
•	Migration of the invoice system from Oracle/Java to Microsoft SQL Server/IIS. 
•	Upgraded the office network to provide increased throughput, Firewall, VPN and DHCP services.
•	Installed a firewall on the production serve site.
•	Generated complex reports from both the Oracle and MS SQL databases.
•	Developed a private label version of the tracking system for one of the larger clients.
•	Developed migration scripts and plans needed to transition from the Oracle/Java system to the Microsoft SQL Server/IIS system.
•	Aided in the development of the program for hand held scanners used to collect barcode data.
•	Designed and implemented the application used to transfer and translate the data collected form the scanners into the system.
•	Developed interface templates using HTML, Javascript, ASP and DHTML to maintain a consistent look and feel.

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description:
•	Project Lead for several of web based applications for use on the Consumer Website including web based tools for administration and reporting.  Projects include: Message Boards, Product Showcase, Design Gallery, Manufacturer’s Listings, Cost Estimators.
•	Design and Implementation of several systems using Microsoft SQL Server, VB Script/ASP, JavaScript ,HTML, DHTML, XML, Visual Basic, ISAPI and ActiveX.  All systems include web interfaces for administrative and reporting functions.
	o	Design and implementation of website tracking and the migration to WebTrends.
	o	Project Lead for the design and implementation of the Co-branding System used for integration of content to and from Patner/Affiliate websites.
	o	Project Lead for the design and implementation of the affiliate/partner tracking system to provide reporting capabilities for the Marketing, Partnership and Editorial departments.
	o	Design and implementation of an application for Partnerships, Marketing and Editorial departments to target ads with page level granularity.
	o	Responsible for the integration of Double-Click ad service into the Consumer and Professional websites.
	o	Design and implementation of the Project Submission Path used to gather trade specific information about a project.
	o	Project Lead for the design and implementation of a system used to automate communication to homeowners about their projects.  The system was also used to schedule communication to various segments of the Registered users in the system.
	o	Design and implementation of a system used to dynamically apply system wide changes in business rules.
	o	Project Lead in the design and implementation of a system used to automate the project screening process.
•	Develop deployment and migration plans minimizing downtime.  Zero downtime in most cases.

positions.title: Product Development Manager and Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Design and implement web based applications using Microsoft IIS, Microsoft SQL Server, Active Server Pages, VB Script, JavaScript and HTML for SBC and Pacific Bell.
•	Design and implement proprietary client software using Visual Basic to interface with Microsoft SQL Server 6.5
•	Design and implementation of an online audio/visual marketing application, Cybergain, using ASP, Javascript, VBScript, HTML, SQL.
•	Administrator for all company servers
•	Webmaster for Cyradus Corporation
•	Researched new technologies to incorporate into current and future products and services

positions.title: Technical Support Manager and Presale Engineer
positions.description:
•	Network administrator for the Hi-Image US Office.
•	Conducted competitive analysis of imaging software products (English/Japanese/French/German)
•	Design and development of proprietary applications used internally by Hi-Image Inc. using Visual Basic, VBScript/ASP.
•	In direct charge of all computer operations and support for Hi-Image Inc. (USA).
•	Planning, configuration and implementation of Hi-Image Inc. Intranet.
•	Planning and implementation of training programs for new technicians and sales representatives.
•	Design and Implementation of multi-user databases using client/server architecture for Technical Support, Sales and Call Tracking using 4Th Dimension and Filemaker Pro.
•	Worked closely with the Software Development team to test and direct new product development.

positions.title: Software Analyst
positions.description:
•	Provided QA, support and deployment of both commercial and proprietary software used by Philip Morris
•	Provided hardware and software support for Apple Macintosh desktop and PowerBook computers.
•	Trained new sales representatives on hardware and software usage.
